items.quote: The DSC apparatus used is a TA Q600 SDT. The sample and reference cell units are in the same reaction chamber that is purged with high-purity nitrogen in order to prevent sample oxidation.

items.calibration: calibrated using Au (99.999%), SiO2 (99.999%), Sn (99.99%) and In (99.999%) under the same experimental conditions. After these calibrations, pure Cu (99.99%) was used to make further calibration of enthalpy
items.quote: Before measurements, the temperature and the enthalpy of reaction were calibrated using Au (99.999%), SiO2 (99.999%), Sn (99.99%) and In (99.999%) under the same experimental conditions. After these calibrations, pure Cu (99.99%) was used to make further calibration of enthalpy. Each calibration was repeated three times, the average value of enthalpies was taken as the standard. DSC measurements were conducted at a heating rate of 10 K/min, and repeated more than 3 times for each composition.
